title: Listening Drill — Collecting local recipes — Guided practice
description: Practical demonstration. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Collecting local recipes — Guided practice
sections.transcript:
TUTOR: Before our demonstration on collecting local recipes, let me explain what you need and what to record. Collect your materials from the kitchen lobby before the demonstration begins. Inside the handout you will find a blank recipe copy to fill in.

TUTOR: Watch the demonstration once before you try it. Before you begin, check for the fault that affected the previous group: smudged notes. If you notice it, let me know instead of making an adjustment yourself.

TUTOR: Now work in pairs. After the first attempt, check ingredient order and write the result down immediately. You then have twenty-five minutes to compare your result with your partner’s. You can disagree, but both partners should keep a note of what they observed.

TUTOR: On your way out, take anything you borrowed back to the village hall. Please leave your notes in the folder so we can discuss them next time.
